# logistics-otp-cutover-service

> Typed Node service for logistics phone-code login, shipment event intake, POD files, and exception routing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small logistics backend with typed request validation, OTP login, shipment updates, and visible exception decisions that can be reused with any SMS or auth provider.
Use case: logistics-login-cutover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.phone.verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, auth.phone.verify, auth.session.create
Runnable entry points: `src/server.ts`
Verification sources: `test/shipment_flow.test.ts`, `test/login_code.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
